svg.title: What one group and one stripe survive at default settings
svg.desc: A grid of guaranteed fragments lost against extra fragments still held for one group with 16 data, 8 guaranteed parity and 8 extra parity slots: readable without repair above 20 distinct slots, readable with repair due from 16 to 20, lost below 16. Below it, the number of groups a stripe of 1 to 32 data chunks can lose.
svg.text: Inner code of one group: 16 data, 8 guaranteed and 8 extra parity slots. Each cell shows the distinct slots still held.
21 or more slots: readable, no repair yet
Outer code of one stripe: groups it can lose, by data chunks in the stripe (outerParityPercent 50)
